messages:
Ruth K: Heads-up from Sales  Customer Helion Systems disputing a bulk training embed line on INV-2027-9001. They claim test jobs were charged as production. Asking for retro exception and a price override for next quarter.
Omar J: How big is the disputed amount and what do they want?
Ruth K: Disputed line $18,200 (embed-heavy training). Customer requests 100% credit on $6,800 they claim were test runs, plus a temporary negotiated rate of $0.0006/emb for Q2 to finish onboarding.
Priya M: Need evidence the runs were test (timestamps, project IDs). Also check whether they used a sandbox org or prod keys. Ops logs?
billing-bot: Link: <https://internal.redwood.com/usage/trace/HELI-998|HELI-998>  shows 18 jobs from project "helion-testbed" between 2027-04-02 and 2027-04-04. No sandbox flag present.
Ruth K: Sales says customer used prod keys by accident; they filed support ticket SUP-7788 acknowledging user error and requesting mercy while they finish migration.
Priya M: Deal Desk criteria: 1) Confirmed user error vs platform fault 2) Materiality 3) Business outcome (will they convert?). Also avoid setting precedent where prod-key mistakes get full refunds.
Omar J: I propose partial remediation: 60% credit on the disputed test-run portion = $4,080, plus temporary rate of $0.0008/emb (vs standard 0.0012) for one quarter conditioned on signed commitment to finish onboarding and an ops checklist to avoid recurrence.
legal-bot: Add clause: credit conditional on signed non-precedent waiver and no future retro claims for the same incident.
Priya M: Approver note: Approved one-time credit $4,080 (60% of disputed $6,800) capped at $5,000. Conditions: (1) Customer signs onboarding completion commitment and waiver, (2) Sales to update SFDC opp OPP-8123 with addendum, (3) Finance to code GL ADJ-MISC-27 and issue CM-2027-5501. Approver: Priya M.
Ruth K: I'll send the addendum and inform customer. billing-bot: please prepare credit memo draft.
billing-bot: Drafted CM-2027-5501, status: pending. GL: ADJ-MISC-27.
Omar J: I'll attach the waiver document and schedule follow-up in 45 days to confirm onboarding progress.
Ruth K: Thanks all  closing loop once CM is posted. :white_check_mark:
